## Overview

- **Dates:** August 24–26, 2026
- **Venue:** Kavli IPMU, The University of Tokyo
- **Organizers:**
  - Kantaro Ohmori (RIKEN)
  - Shuhei Ohyama (RIKEN)
  - Mayuko Yamashita (Perimeter / RIKEN)
  - Yuji Tachikawa (Kavli IPMU)

## Program

Three-day lecture series by [Bowen Yang](https://yangbowenmath.github.io/yangbowenmath/index.html), based on joint work with Mattie Ji ([arXiv:2602.16572](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16572) and [arXiv:2606.19657](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19657)), in which quantum cellular automata are classified by an algebraic K-theory spectrum.

**Title:** TBD

| Date            | Time          |
|-----------------|---------------|
| Mon, August 24  | 15:30 – 17:00 |
| Tue, August 25  | 15:30 – 17:00 |
| Wed, August 26  | 15:30 – 17:00 |

## Related event

The related program [*Physics and Mathematics of Generalized Symmetry in QFT*](https://indico.ipmu.jp/event/523/) runs August 24–28 at Kavli IPMU, in different time slots so the two do not conflict. Participants are encouraged to attend both.

## Registration

Registration for in-person attendance: [Google Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSefLIm05c3cNIB5a3Kp1_X_1vajeVNr5n26lC7Bvv422hudMg/viewform?usp=header).

Update on Aug 23: There will be a Zoom broadcast. The Zoom link is the same as for the above Generalized Symmetry Conference. If you would like the link but will not participate in the event, please contact the organizer at the email address below. Sorry for the late announcement.
